3.4.1.3-f106.text: caedem scripturarum faciunt ad materiam suam

translations.literal: they make a slaughter of the scriptures toward their own matter
translations.note: Adapted from Tertullian, De praescriptione haereticorum 38. There Tertullian says Marcion used a sword rather than a pen, 'since he made a slaughter of the Scriptures to suit his own subject-matter' ('ad materiam suam caedem scripturarum confecit'). Burton changes it to the plural, 'faciunt', so that it applies to heretics in general.
